## Description
Deploys and validates infrastructure. Two modes — (1) Supabase local/staging: apply migrations, deploy edge functions, validate RLS, smoke test; (2) GCP cloud/production: Terraform IaC, Cloud Run, Firebase Hosting, staging validation. Outputs to artefacts/supabase/ or artefacts/gcp/.
